name: Hiyama Shinji
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'loyalty' on his body.
A frivolous person who talks Kansai dialect, but he is actually a very perceptive and calm person.
A gourmand who eats a lot but stays thin, but he won't eat cheap things.
